The '''1991–92 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], nine points ahead of [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Hearts]]. [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]] and [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline Athletic]] were relegated to the [[1992–93 Scottish First Division|1992–93 First Division]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/premier-division/1991-1992/table |title=Scottish Premier Division 1991-1992 : Table |publisher=Statto.com |access-date=2012-02-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110907001145/http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/premier-division/1991-1992/table |archive-date=2011-09-07 |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[UEFA]] gave a third place for the [[UEFA Cup]] to Scotland after the disbandment of former [[East Germany]].
